newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansa Bank says to launch Estonia share options.
newsitem.headline: Hansa Bank says to launch Estonia share options.

text.p: Estonia's leading bank, Hansa Bank, said on Monday that it had begun issuing share options in the leading companies listed on the fledgeling Tallinn Bourse, which was launched in the spring.
"We have made share option contracts worth just under 10 million kroons," Hansa Bank analyst Tonis Haavel told Reuters.
He added that the bank only planned to issue share options in companies with high levels of liquidity.
Hansa Bank, which has also entered the currency options market, is the first Baltic financial instititution to issue share options.
Hansa Bank is the largest bank in the Baltic states with assets of 4.9 billion kroons and a net profit of 128 million kroons for the first nine months of 1996.
